description: [Ncloud Storage] List in-progress (not yet completed or aborted) multipart uploads in a bucket (GET /?uploads). Incomplete uploads keep consuming storage until completed or aborted — use this to find leftovers, then ncloud_ncs_abort_multipart_upload.

bucketName.description: Name of the Ncloud Storage bucket

keyMarker.description: Pagination: nextKeyMarker of the previous page

prefix.description: Only uploads whose key starts with this prefix

uploadIdMarker.description: Pagination: nextUploadIdMarker of the previous page (requires keyMarker)

name: ncloud_ncs_list_multipart_uploads
